The last row is the mean over the five covered breaking changes with its 95\% bootstrap interval over runs.}{按数据变化与方法划分的用户端智能体正确率（\%），DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，每种方法 3 次独立运行，底色越深越高。红色角标表示该情形下至少 25\% 的题使用了过期定义，即其规范 SQL 在该情形下答错的定义。末行为条件覆盖的 5 种破坏性变化的平均值及其按运行自助重抽样的 95\% 区间。}}
\label{fig:scenarios}
\Description{Heatmap of accuracy with twelve settings as rows, grouped into none, benign, grain, join fan-out, completeness, not covered, and ambiguous fix, and nine methods as columns; each cell shows the percentage. Sharing methods reach about 100 percent on held-out and benign settings. Under the grain changes MAVRA answers 100, 93, and 59 percent, while schema-change invalidation falls to 44 to 78 percent with red corners for stale definitions. All methods are low under the date-key format change; under the unit change several methods, MAVRA included, are marked as using stale definitions. Means over the twelve settings: no sharing 32, trajectory retrieval 76, trajectory retrieval plus self-check 77, no validation 75, schema-change invalidation 75, invalidate-on-write 79, definition-level 82, MAVRA 81, MAVRA with G8 on current data 80. Over the five covered breaking changes, with 95 percent intervals: no sharing 19, trajectory retrieval 57, self-check 63, no validation 58, schema-change invalidation 59, invalidate-on-write 69, definition-level 74 (69 to 78), MAVRA 73 (69 to 76), MAVRA with G8 on current data 72 (69 to 76).}
